_about: Third-party reference documents the skills read for detail beyond their own summaries. They are NOT in this repo (their licences are not MIT): each user keeps a local copy under refs/ (gitignored). tools/fetch_refs.py checks the copies (present + sha256) and restores missing ones from this repo's history or the listed sources.
